title: Particle Cage
body:
Syntax: perform particle cage <target>

Description: A Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) attack that strikes one target. Paralysis briefly blocks the target's actions.  Requires Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 10300-10700. 35% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 100. Costs 125 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 22 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
